test_use: One sealed reporting campaign after all selections, operating points, and likelihood calibrations are frozen
title: Controlled prediction
development_likelihood_calibration: parent-separated development snapshots only; final calibration remains locked

success_criterion.definition: 2 consecutive safe steps inside the unchanged goal region with ball speed below 0.15 m/s; stop at success

uncertainty.training_fit: One predeclared fit per family (seed 13); no retraining-variation interval.
uncertainty.episode_proportion: Primary: 20,000-draw block bootstrap over ten locked proposal-trial seeds with all nine fixed cases retained per trial; supplemental: Clopper-Pearson exact episode interval.
uncertainty.paired_effect: Deterministic paired block bootstrap over the same ten locked proposal-trial seeds; retain all nine case-wise differences inside each resampled trial.
uncertainty.scope: Proposal-trial variation for seed 13 conditional on nine fixed physical conditions.
